description: This file sets up and tests GPG (GNU Privacy Guard) environments and configurations, manages GPG-related keys and trust settings, and includes functions for preparing GPG home directories and performing prerequisite checks. It also contains setup for GPG SSH signing keys and tests related to GPG and SSH authentication methods.

methods.name: prepare_gnupghome
methods.description: Creates the GPG home directory and sets permissions to 0700 to prepare for GPG operations.

methods.name: test_lazy_prereq GPG
methods.description: Checks for the presence of GPG, verifies the version, sets up the GPG home, and imports keys and trust data for GPG v1.

methods.name: test_lazy_prereq GPG2
methods.description: Checks for the presence of GPG, verifies the version, sets up the GPG home, and imports keys and trust data for GPG v2.

methods.name: test_lazy_prereq GPGSM
methods.description: Checks for GPGSM prerequisites, sets up the environment, and imports GPGSM certificates and keys.

methods.name: test_lazy_prereq RFC1991
methods.description: Runs a test for GPG RFC1991 compliance.

methods.name: test_lazy_prereq GPGSSH
methods.description: Sets up GPG SSH keys and allowed signers file, and verifies basic signing and verification functionality.

methods.name: test_lazy_prereq GPGSSH_VERIFYTIME
methods.description: Tests GPG SSH keys with time constraints and verifies their validity within specified time frames.

methods.name: sanitize_pgp
methods.description: Removes PGP encryption/decryption blocks from input via sed command.
